title: Advanced Paste reasoning models reject Chat Completions function tools

judgment.rationale: The exact API error and September 30 confirmation on stable 0.101.2362 support a reasoning-model tool incompatibility. Current AdvancedAIKernelService still registers OpenAI Chat Completions and automatic function tools without a reasoning-effort setting. Endpoint or capability policy remains unverified, so retain the yellow proposal and reproduce first.
evidence: Reporter comparison: Advanced AI off succeeds; enabling built-in functions for gpt-6-luna returns HTTP 400 with reasoning_effort/tool incompatibility.
At current main 3d6827a53a579ba9bedcf8d4bbda21348d78cbdb, AdvancedAIKernelService uses AddOpenAIChatCompletion and FunctionChoiceBehavior.Auto without reasoning-effort setting.
#49838 concerns explicit reasoning_effort=minimal in custom actions; #47292 concerns a different Responses API/model path.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve bounded compatibility investigation and reproduce the function-tool request before choosing capability-aware routing or request settings.

fix_assessment.rationale: Exact error and current Chat Completions/tool path support a compatibility hypothesis; safe capability signal and endpoint/parameter choice need reproduction.

proposed_fixes.title: Make Advanced AI tool calls compatible with reasoning-model APIs
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: AdvancedAIKernelService enables automatic tools on OpenAI Chat Completions, while the reported model rejects that request unless reasoning is disabled or a supported endpoint is used. Correct capability policy is unestablished.
plan: Reproduce on current build with same model/provider and Advanced AI toggled off/on; record endpoint and settings without credentials.
Determine a provider/model capability signal for supported tool calls without applying reasoning_effort=none to models that reject it.
Implement a scoped capability-aware route or request setting while preserving Azure OpenAI and ordinary models.
Add focused coverage for the reasoning model and unchanged ordinary-model behavior.
verification: Repeat gpt-6-luna sequence and verify tool request succeeds through supported API path.
Verify incompatible reasoning_effort is not sent and moderation remains intact.
Run focused Advanced Paste tests and build.

confidence.rationale: Error and current request setup align closely, but capability signal and endpoint choice need reproduction.
